<details><summary>Thinking</summary>

Confirmed bug: at ry=178 (card flipped to show back), we see the FRONT face （圣龙 with rainbow). The back branch never triggers — because at ry=178° the visible face is the -z side, but `gl_FrontFacing` returns true for it since with DoubleSide... no wait — gl_FrontFacing depends on winding order, not camera direction. The -z face of the box has its own triangles wound so that they ARE front-facing when viewed from behind... Actually gl_FrontFacing is determined by the triangle's winding order in screen space, considering `material.side`. For DoubleSide rendering, gl_FrontFacing is computed from the geometric winding BEFORE flipping — it returns whether the fragment belongs to a front-facing triangle as rasterized. For the box's -z face viewed from behind, its triangles were authored to be front-facing when viewed from -z... In three.js, BoxGeometry's -z face triangles have winding such that their face normal is -z; when you look at them from behind the card, they appear front-facing (counter-clockwise from that viewpoint). So gl_FrontFacing == TRUE even when viewing the back! That's why the back branch never fires — gl_FrontFacing can't distinguish card front from card back here; both sides of a closed box are "front facing" from their own side.

Fix: don't use gl_FrontFacing; use the object-space normal: card front = vNrm.z > 0 (the +z face), back = vNrm.z < 0. Edge faces have |z| small. So:

```glsl
bool front = N.z > 0.0; // N = normalize(vNrm) in object space
```
But wait — the user's message said the spec uses gl_FrontFacing... in the reference they probably had a single-plane mesh (not a closed box) where backface is truly back-facing. With RoundedBoxGeometry (closed solid), use normal.z. Edge/corner pixels (rounded rim) with z≈0 → front branch (foil on rim — fine, looks like foil edge).

Also "做一个卡背" might also mean the back design should be nicer, but the primary bug is back shows front. Fix the branch condition and re-verify with screenshot.

卡背修好了，截图验证通过：

**问题根因**：之前用 `gl_FrontFacing` 区分正背面，但 RoundedBoxGeometry 是**闭合实体盒**——它的 -z 面三角形在从背面看时同样是"正面"环绕序，`gl_FrontFacing` 恒为 true，背面分支永远进不去，所以正反都显示卡面。

**修复**：
- 改用物体空间法线判断：`N.z < 0` 即卡背（圆角侧边归正面，边缘带箔更好看）。
- 卡背是独立程序绘制：深靛蓝竖渐变 + 260 星点 + 双圆环 + 中央 🂠 牌背纹 + "MAGIC · THE · TRAVELING" 底字，**任何角度无箔、哑光**，不是正面的镜像。
- 顺带撤掉了一处错误的 UV 镜像修正（盒体 -z 面 UV 本来就是正向，之前反而把底字镜像了）。

现在转 178° 看到的就是这张独立卡背，转回来正面全息箔不变。需要推送部署说一声。

```js
  // 效果文本区：词条/战吼亡语/单位法术的具体效果
  const VT = window.VIEWER_TEXT || { traits: {}, spell: {}, unitSpell: {}, spellFx: {} };
  const traitDesc = t => VT.traits[t] || VT.traits[t.replace(/\d+$/, '')] || '';
  const fxLines = [];
  if (isSpell) {
    fxLines.push('【' + def.name + '】' + (VT.spellFx[def.spellEffect] || ''));
  } else {
    (def.traits || []).forEach(t => { const d2 = traitDesc(t); if (d2) fxLines.push('· ' + t + '：' + d2); });
    if (def.spell && VT.spell[def.spell]) fxLines.push('· ' + VT.spell[def.spell]);
    if (def.actSpell && VT.unitSpell[def.actSpell]) fxLines.push('· ' + VT.unitSpell[def.actSpell]);
    (def.actSpells || []).forEach(s => { if (VT.unitSpell[s.key]) fxLines.push('· ' + VT.unitSpell[s.key]); });
  }
  // 自动换行绘制（超出则缩字号）
  let fontSize = 21;
  const wrapLines = [];
  const buildLines = () => {
    wrapLines.length = 0;
    ctx.font = fontSize + 'px "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif';
    fxLines.forEach(line => {
      let cur = '';
      for (const ch of line) {
        if (ctx.measureText(cur + ch).width > 620) { wrapLines.push(cur); cur = ch; }
        else cur += ch;
      }
      if (cur) wrapLines.push(cur);
    });
  };
  buildLines();
  const lineH = fontSize + 7;
  const maxY = 836; // 三围栏上方
  const startY = (ty || 668) + 52;
  if (startY + wrapLines.length * lineH > maxY && fontSize > 16) { fontSize = 16; buildLines(); }
  ctx.fillStyle = '#a8a8c2';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  const lh = fontSize + 7;

```js
function holoLiveHtml(m, def) {
  const L = [];
  const diff = (cur, base, label) => {
    const d = cur - base;
    return label + ' ' + cur + (d !== 0 ? '（基础 ' + base + '，' + (d > 0 ? '+' : '') + d + '）' : '');
  };
  L.push('<b>战场状态</b>');
  L.push(diff(m.atk, m.baseAtk, '攻'));
  L.push('甲 ' + (m.arm != null ? m.arm : '?') + (m.baseArm != null && m.arm !== m.baseArm ? '（基础 ' + m.baseArm + '）' : ''));
  L.push(diff(m.maxHp, m.baseMaxHp, '血上限') + '，当前 ' + Math.max(0, m.curHp));
  const stance = m.faceDown ? '翻面表示' + (m.defense ? '·守备' : '') : m.defense ? '守备表示' : '攻击表示';
  L.push('表示：' + stance + (m.grounded ? ' · 落地' : ''));
  L.push('剩余反击机会：' + m.counterLeft);
  if ((m.morale || 0) !== 0) {
    const mo = m.morale;
    L.push('士气 ' + (mo > 0 ? '+' : '') + mo + '：' + (mo > 0 ? '每点 10% 概率额外行动一次' : '每点 10% 概率无法行动/反击失败'));
  } else L.push('士气 0（中性）');
  if (m.spellManaMax > 0) L.push('法术：' + m.spellMana + '/' + m.spellManaMax);
  if (m.poison > 0) L.push('中毒 Lv' + m.poison + '（每轮部署阶段开始 -' + m.poison + ' 血）');
  if ((m.blind || 0) > 0) L.push('失明 ' + m.blind + ' 回合（无法攻击/反击/施法/切换形态）');
  if ((m.petrified || 0) > 0) L.push('石化 ' + m.petrified + ' 回合（无法行动/反击，护甲 +3）');
  if (m.boonOfLife) L.push('生还的宝礼：在场时我方每次从墓地召唤卡牌摸一张牌');
  const need = def && (def.traits || []).find(t => t.startsWith('觉醒'));
  if (need) L.push('觉醒 ' + (m._awaken || 0) + '/' + need.slice(2));
  // 临时 buff：与基础定义的差值
  const buffs = [];
  if (m.atk - m.baseAtk !== 0) buffs.push('攻 ' + (m.atk - m.baseAtk > 0 ? '+' : '') + (m.atk - m.baseAtk));
  if (m.maxHp - m.baseMaxHp !== 0) buffs.push('血上限 ' + (m.maxHp - m.baseMaxHp > 0 ? '+' : '') + (m.maxHp - m.baseMaxHp));
  if (m.baseArm != null && m.arm - m.baseArm !== 0) buffs.push('甲 +' + (m.arm - m.baseArm));
  const defTraits = def ? def.traits : [];
  m.traits.forEach(t => { if (defTraits.indexOf(t) < 0) buffs.push('获得词条「' + t + '」'); });
  if (buffs.length) L.push('临时 buff：' + buffs.join('，'));
  return L.map(x => '<div>' + x + '</div>').join('');
}

function holoRatingHtml(def) {
  if (!def || def.rating == null) return '';
  const LABEL = (window.VIEWER_TEXT && window.VIEWER_TEXT.unitSpellLabel) || {};
  const w = t => t === '拒马' ? 0.5
    : (t === '飞行' || t === '远程' || t === '石像形态') ? 3
    : t.startsWith('法术护盾') ? (parseInt(t.slice(4), 10) || 1)
    : t.startsWith('再生') ? (parseInt(t.slice(2), 10) || 1)
    : t.startsWith('觉醒') ? 0 : 2;
  const parts = [];
  if (def.type === 'spell') parts.push('法术 2');
  else {
    parts.push('血 ' + def.hp, '攻 ' + def.atk);
    if (def.arm) parts.push('甲 ' + def.arm + '×3');
    (def.traits || []).forEach(t => parts.push(t + ' ' + w(t)));
    if (def.spell) parts.push('卡牌特效 2');
    if (def.actSpell) parts.push((LABEL[def.actSpell] || '单位法术') + ' 2');
    (def.actSpells || []).forEach(s => parts.push((LABEL[s.key] || s.key) + ' 2'));
  }
  return '<b>战斗力 ' + def.rating + '</b>' + parts.map(p => '<div>+ ' + p + '</div>').join('');
}

// 执行一次反击：士气判定 → 复仇累积 → 伤害结算（含石化凝视）。
// isDefense=true 为守备表示的同时结算反击（不耗反击机会、无需存活判定——即使被打死也结算）
function executeCounter(target, attacker, attackerSide, shaken, depth, isDefense) {
  if (moraleFail(target)) {
    log('【' + target.name + '】士气低落，未能反击' + (isDefense ? '' : '（反击机会保留）'));
    moraleFx(target, 'down');
    return;
  }
  const vg = traitLv(target, '复仇');
  if (vg > 0) { target.baseAtk += vg; target.atk += vg; log('【' + target.name + '】复仇：攻击 +' + vg + '（当前 ' + target.atk + '）'); }
  if (!isDefense) target.counterLeft--;
  const back = attackDamage(target, attacker);
  if (back <= 0) {
    log('【' + target.name + '】' + (isDefense ? '（守备）' : '') + '反击【' + attacker.name + '】，伤害被护甲完全抵挡' + (isDefense ? '' : '（本阶段反击机会已用）'));
    return;
  }
  sfx('counter');
  dealAttackDamage(target, otherSide(attackerSide), attacker, back, shaken, depth + 1, isDefense ? 'defcounter' : 'counter');
  if (target.traits.includes('石化凝视') && Math.random() < 0.5) {

  }
}

    : t.startsWith('觉醒') ? 0 : 2;

    const base = (c.hp||0)+(c.atk||0)+(c.arm||0)*3;

    if (c.spell) kw += 2;
    if (c.actSpell) kw += 2;
    (c.actSpells||[]).forEach(() => kw += 2);
    if (c.type === 'spell') kw += 2;
    c.rating = base + kw;
  });
  fs.writeFileSync(CARDS_JSON, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\n');

}

When user clicks 开卡包（100🪙) in deck builder:

2. Open holo overlay in pack mode; when torn open, spawnFan uses THOSE 5 cards (instead of random).
3. After fan completes (all flipped), auto-commit to collection + log summary; user clicks a card to inspect it (current behavior) or 「返回」 to go back to builder.

Simplest robust flow:
- buyPack: if window.__holo exists → open holo in pack mode with the rolled cards; otherwise old 2D flow.
- Module side: add `pendingPackCards` variable + `__holo.openPack(defs)`:
  - open overlay, setMode('pack'), store defs.
  - spawnFan uses `state.pendingPackCards || random`.
  - after tear (setMode('fan')), call game's commit callback: `if (window.__packCommit) window.__packCommit()` — module calls it; game side commits to collection.
- Game side: new function `buyPack3D()`:
  ```js
  function buyPack3D() {
    if (gold < PACK_PRICE || packCards) return false;
    gold -= PACK_PRICE;
    packCards = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < PACK_SIZE; i++) packCards.push(CARD_DEFS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CARD_DEFS.length)]);
    packRevealed = packCards.map(() => true); // 3D 流程视为已全部翻开
    saveEconomy();
    sfx('pack');
    window.__packCommit = () => {
      commitPack(); // 入库 + 显示 summary？commitPack writes pack-summary & hides 2D buttons — fine but summary element is in 2D overlay; harmless.
      window.__packCommit = null;
    };
    window.__holo.openPack(packCards);
    updateGoldUi();
    return true;
  }
  ```

  And when holo closes after pack opened, renderBuilder() to refresh collection display. Hook: in module close() → if viewer opened from pack, call `window.__packClosed && window.__packClosed()`. Game side set `window.__packClosed = () => { renderBuilder(); window.__packClosed = null; }`.

buyFactionPack(race):
```js
function buyFactionPack(race) {
  if (gold < FACTION_PACK_PRICE || packCards || !window.__holo) return false;
  const pool = CARD_DEFS.filter(d => d.race === race);
  if (pool.length === 0) return false;
  gold -= FACTION_PACK_PRICE;
  const defs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < PACK_SIZE; i++) defs.push(pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]);
  saveEconomy();
  sfx('pack');
  window.__packCommit = () => { grantCards(defs); log('【阵营卡包】已收入收藏：' + defs.map(d => d.name).join('、')); window.__packCommit = null; };
  window.__packClosed = () => { renderBuilder(); window.__packClosed = null; };
  window.__holo.openPack(defs);
  updateGoldUi();
  return true;
}
```
buyFactionBox(race):
```js
function buyFactionBox(race) {
  if (gold < FACTION_BOX_PRICE || packCards || !window.__holo) return false;
  const pool = CARD_DEFS.filter(d => d.race === race);
  if (!pool.length) return false;
  gold -= FACTION_BOX_PRICE;
  const queue = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
    const defs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < PACK_SIZE; i++) defs.push(pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]);
    queue.push(defs);
  }
  saveEconomy();
  sfx('pack');
  const openNext = () => {
    const defs = queue.shift();
    if (!defs) return;
    window.__packCommit = () => { grantCards(defs); window.__packCommit = null; };
    if (queue.length === 0) window.__packClosed = () => { renderBuilder(); window.__packClosed = null; };
    window.__holo.openPack(defs, queue.length + 1, 5);
  };
  openNext();
  updateGoldUi();
  return true;
}
```

let albumRace = RACES[0];
function renderAlbum() {
  const body = document.getElementById('album-body');
  const chips = RACES.map(r => '<span class="filter-chip' + (r === albumRace ? '' : ' off') + '" data-action="album-race" data-val="' + r + '">' + r + '</span>').join('');
  const cards = CARD_DEFS.filter(d => d.race === albumRace).sort((a,b) => a.cost - b.cost || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  const owned = cards.filter(d => (collection[d.name] || 0) > 0).length;
  const complete = cards.length > 0 && owned === cards.length;
  const claimed = !!claimedAlbums[albumRace];
  body.innerHTML =
    '<h3>集卡册</h3><div class="filter-row">' + chips + '</div>' +
    '<div class="gp-side">' + albumRace + '：' + owned + ' / ' + cards.length + ' 张' + (claimed ? '（已领取传说奖励）' : '') + '</div>' +
    '<div class="album-grid">' + cards.map(d => {
      const n = collection[d.name] || 0;
      return '<div class="album-mini' + (n === 0 ? ' locked' : '') + '" data-action="album-card" data-name="' + d.name + '" title="双击 3D 检视">' +
        '<div class="c-cost">' + d.cost + '</div><div class="c-name">' + (d.legend ? '★' : '') + d.name + '</div>' +
        artHtml(d) + '<div class="album-own">' + (n > 0 ? '拥有 ×' + n : '未收集') + '</div></div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>' +
    (complete && !claimed
      ? '<button class="btn" id="album-claim" style="margin-top:8px">🎁 集齐了！领取随机传说卡</button>'
      : '');
}
```

  if (faceCache[def.name]) return faceCache[def.name];

  faceCache[def.name] = url;

}

For race color gradient, I need hsl from hex race color: reuse a small helper: `function raceShade(race, l) { ... }` — the game has RACE_DOT array (index by RACES). Write:
```js
function raceShade(race, l) {
  const i = RACES.indexOf(race);
  const hex = RACE_DOT[i] || '#888888';
  const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  const r = (n >> 16 & 255) / 255, g = (n >> 8 & 255) / 255, b = (n & 255) / 255;
  const mx = Math.max(r, g, b), mn = Math.min(r, g, b);
  const li = (mx + mn) / 2;
  let h = 0, s = 0;
  if (mx !== mn) {
    const d = mx - mn;
    s = li > 0.5 ? d / (2 - mx - mn) : d / (mx + mn);
    if (mx === r) h = (g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0);
    else if (mx === g) h = (b - r) / d + 2;
    else h = (r - g) / d + 4;
    h *= 60;
  }
  return 'hsl(' + Math.round(h) + ',' + Math.round(s * 100) + '%,' + l + '%)';
}
```

Root cause: __holo.open(cardName) currently sets state.cardIdx + refreshTextures but does NOT reset mode to 'viewer'. If mode was 'fan'/'boxfan'/'pack', the overlay opens in that old mode (showing the fan page). Fix: in open(), force setMode('viewer') and clear returnMode/boxBatches.

Also "无法完全退出": close() checks state.returnMode — if returnMode is set from an earlier fan inspection, closing returns to fan page instead of exiting. When opening fresh from outside, returnMode should be cleared so close() actually closes.

Fix in open(cardName, liveMinion):

    setMode('viewer');
    document.getElementById('holo-viewer').classList.add('show');

```

  const pool = CARD_DEFS.filter(d => d.legend);
  if (pool.length === 0 || claimedAlbums[albumRace]) return;
  const legend = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
  claimedAlbums[albumRace] = true;

  renderAlbum();
  updateGoldUi();
  if (window.__holo) window.__holo.open(legend.name);
}

function claimAlbumReward3D(race) {
  if (!race || claimedAlbums[race] || !albumRaceComplete(race)) return;
  const pool = CARD_DEFS.filter(d => d.legend);
  if (pool.length === 0) return;
  const legend = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
  claimedAlbums[race] = true;

    state.cardIdx = ci;
    buildCardOptions('');
    cardSel.value = String(ci);
    refreshTextures();
    state.returnMode = 'album-binder';
    setMode('viewer');
  }
}

<details><summary>Thinking</summary>

The user says the 3D album has many perspective, occlusion, and page-flipping problems. This is vague but points at the 3D binder rendering. Let me look at the current implementation and identify the issues:

1. **透视 (perspective)**: The binder group has `rotation.x = 0.6` and cards/page use `rotation.x = -Math.PI/2 + 0.08` — mixing rotations probably makes cards not lie flat on the page, weird angles.

2. **遮挡 (occlusion)**: Cards are planes at y=0.07 above page at y=0.05 — z-fighting or cards hidden behind page; the binder body at y=-1.35, page group at y=-1.2. Also the shelf back board might occlude books. Also when flipping, the page rotates around Y but the cards stay... Actually during flip, `renderBinderPage()` is called mid-flip which removes and re-adds cards — the flip animation probably looks wrong (page content swaps halfway, page rotates around left edge but the page mesh is positioned at x=3.55 within pageGroup at x=-3.55, so rotation around pageGroup's Y axis — the left edge. OK).

3. **翻页 (page flip)**: The flip rotates `pageGroup.rotation.y` by ±π. With rotation.x=0.6 on parent, the page sweeps through the binder body — likely intersects the body/rings, causing occlusion artifacts. Also after flipping to next page, the previous page just vanishes — no page on the left side, looks wrong. Also page flip direction: rotating y by -π flips the page over to the left, but then rotation resets to 0 and new page appears — the old page disappears abruptly.

The user wants these fixed. Best approach: rebuild the binder with a cleaner structure:

- Binder lies flatter, camera looks down at it more directly, or keep tilt but make everything consistent.

// ---- 活页夹：中缝书脊双页展开 ----
const BINDER = {
  pageW: 5.9, pageD: 6.6,   // 单页尺寸
  coverW: 13.0, coverD: 7.3,
  cardW: 1.7, cardH: 2.38,
  colX: [1.25, 3.1, 4.95],  // 相对页左缘（中缝侧为 0）
  rowZ: [-2.05, 0, 2.05],
  tiltMin: 0.15, tiltMax: 1.05,
};

function parchmentMat() {
  if (!texCache['__parch']) texCache['__parch'] = makeTex(makeParchmentTex());
  return new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: texCache['__parch'], side: THREE.DoubleSide });
}
function cardBackMat() {
  if (!texCache['__back']) texCache['__back'] = makeTex(drawCardBack());
  return new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: texCache['__back'] });
}

function buildBinder(race) {
  if (album.binderGroup) scene.remove(album.binderGroup);
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  scene.add(g);
  album.binderGroup = g;
  g.rotation.x = 0.5;
  g.position.y = -0.2;
  album.race = race;
  album.pageIdx = 0;
  album.pageCount = Math.ceil(CARD_DEFS.filter(d => d.race === race).length / 9);
  album.flipT = -1;
  album.tiltY = 0;

  // 封面夹体
  const cover = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(BINDER.coverW, 0.24, BINDER.coverD),
    new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2a1c12 }));
  cover.position.y = -0.14;
  g.add(cover);
  // 三环
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.22, 0.04, 8, 20),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xc8c0b0 }));
    ring.position.set(0, 0.02, -2.2 + i * 2.2);
    ring.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
    g.add(ring);

集卡册的透视、遮挡和翻页问题已重构完成并部署（`5f6991b`）。这次发现的三个根本问题：

- **卡袋不渲染**：页堆盒子的顶面比页面和卡袋还高，把所有内容都压住了——你看到的“页面”其实是页堆的顶面。修复后，页面放在页堆之上，页堆厚度随页数变化（index.html:12119 `renderBinderIdle`）。
- **纹理报错**：`makeParchmentTex()` 返回的本来就是 THREE 纹理，我又包了一层 `makeTex()`，把纹理对象当图像上传。
- **左页卡背不可见**：静止左页的卡背用了翻页时用于活动页面的朝下方向，视角下看不见；现在静止页一律朝上。

同时，活页夹的整体结构也重做了：

- 中缝书脊位于中央，活页夹呈双页展开（符合万智牌集卡册的常见形态），不再使用单页加窄封皮；翻页时页面不会再悬空甩出夹体。
- 翻页动画：活动页面带卡牌绕书脊翻转 180°，翻过 90° 后露出卡背，落在左页；左页平时就显示上一页的卡背面，与真实卡册一致。
- 拖动改为倾斜整个活页夹（上下调俯仰、左右调侧倾，带范围限制），取代之前把页面拖出夹体的“滚动”。
- 集卡册模式下隐藏左侧调试面板，书架上的 13 本书不再被遮挡。

playwright 已逐帧验证：书架→开册→翻页→卡背页→翻回→倾斜→点卡检视→Esc 返回→领取传说卡，全程无控制台错误。本地仍可在 http://127.0.0.1:8474/index.html 试。

<details><summary>Thinking</summary>

The user says: the bookshelf spacing is not tall enough — the binders/books are clipping through （穿模） the shelf boards. Looking at nb0-shelf.png: books on row 0 sit on board at y=-1.4, row 1 books at y=-2.22 sit on board at y=-3.6. Book heights vary: 2.5 + (i%3)*0.18 → 2.5, 2.68, 2.86. Row 0 books at y=-0.02 → bottom at -0.02 - h/2. For h=2.5: bottom=-1.27; board top at -1.4+0.125=-1.275. OK just touching. For h=2.86: bottom = -0.02-1.43 = -1.45 → sinks 0.175 into the board! 穿模.

But stacks (stackR slab) aren't adjusted during flip — the slab keeps the old height; the preview page at yR2 (slightly lower than the flip page's original yR) — the stackR top would be ABOVE the preview page by 0.03! Because stackR height hR stays, stack top = -0.02+hR, preview page yR2 = -0.02+hR-0.03+0.004 → BELOW stack top → preview page buried in the stack!! Need to also lower stackR during forward flip: hR' = (pageCount-pageIdx-2)*0.03. Let me just recompute both stack heights in startFlip forward: stackR scale to remaining-1.

Simpler: in startFlip forward, temporarily set stackR as if pageIdx already incremented, and place preview page accordingly. On cancel... there's no cancel. finishFlip → renderBinderIdle recomputes everything. OK.

Let me write a small helper for stack height: `const stackH = n => Math.min(0.18, Math.max(0.015, n * 0.03));`

renderBinderIdle uses stackH(pageCount-pageIdx-1) and stackH(pageIdx).

startFlip forward:
- stackR.scale.y = stackH(pageCount-pageIdx-2); position.y = -0.02 + h/2.
- preview page y = -0.02 + h + 0.004, pockets +0.012.
- topR gets preview (pageIdx+1).
- topL unchanged (blank page of... wait, at flip start from idle, topL shows blank page (pageIdx>0) or nothing (pageIdx=0). During forward flip, the flip page lands on the left — the idle left after finish will be blank page for the new pageIdx. During the flip, left side shows the flip page's blank back after 90° — consistent.

Backward flip:
- flip page carries page pageIdx-1 fronts, blank back. Starts at z=π (face-down on left, showing blank back).
- topL hidden during flip (its blank page is replaced by flip page's blank back — visually identical anyway).
- topR unchanged (current page stays).
- On finish: pageIdx-- → idle.

One more consideration: the flip page's front cards at local y=+0.015; the back is blank parchment — but the parchment is DoubleSide, so from the back you see parchment ✓ opaque ✓ "不是透明的" ✓.

Also should the left idle page even exist? With blank parchment on the left, it looks like an empty page — real binders: the back of a pocket page IS the front of another pocket page... but the user explicitly wants no card backs and opaque pages. A blank parchment left page reads as "the back of the flipped page" — good.

Alternatively, left could show nothing (just cover). But blank page looks better (stack of flipped pages).

function fillPockets(parent, pageIdx, side, y) {
  const cards = albumCardsOf(album.race, pageIdx);
  cards.forEach((def, k) => {
    const col = k % 3, row = Math.floor(k / 3);
    const ci = CARDS.findIndex(c => c.name === def.name);
    const artKey = def.name + '|art';
    if (!texCache[artKey]) texCache[artKey] = makeTex(drawCardFace(def, ci));
    const n = collection[def.name] || 0;
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(BINDER.cardW, BINDER.cardH),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: n > 0 ? 0xffffff : 0x8a8a8a, transparent: true, opacity: n > 0 ? 1 : 0.55, map: texCache[artKey] }));
    mesh.userData = { ci };
    if (side === 'flipBack') {
      mesh.rotation.set(Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI); // 动页背面：预转 180°，翻过去后文字方向正确
      mesh.position.set(0.15 + BINDER.colX[col], y, BINDER.rowZ[row]);
    } else {
      mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      mesh.position.set((side === 'L' ? -1 : 1) * (0.15 + BINDER.colX[col]), y, BINDER.rowZ[row]);
    }
    parent.add(mesh);
  });
}

  "new_string": "// 一页的 3×3 卡袋内容（均为卡面，可点检视）。\n// side='R' 右页/动页正面（局部 +x 朝上）；side='L' 静止左页（-x 朝上）；\n// side='flipBack' 动页背面（局部朝下并预转 180°，翻到左侧后文字方向正确）\nfunction fillPockets(parent, pageIdx, side, y) {\n  const cards = albumCardsOf(album.race, pageIdx);\n  cards.forEach((def, k) => {\n    const col = k % 3, row = Math.floor(k / 3);\n    const ci = CARDS.findIndex(c => c.name === def.name);\n    const artKey = def.name + '|art';\n    if (!texCache[artKey]) texCache[artKey] = makeTex(drawCardFace(def, ci));\n    const n = collection[def.name] || 0;\n    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(BINDER.cardW, BINDER.cardH),\n      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: n > 0 ? 0xffffff : 0x8a8a8a, transparent: true, opacity: n > 0 ? 1 : 0.55, map: texCache[artKey] }));\n    mesh.userData = { ci };\n    if (side === 'flipBack') {\n      mesh.rotation.set(Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI);\n      mesh.position.set(0.15 + BINDER.colX[col], y, BINDER.rowZ[row]);\n    } else {\n      mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;\n      mesh.position.set((side === 'L' ? -1 : 1) * (0.15 + BINDER.colX[col]), y, BINDER.rowZ[row]);\n    }\n    parent.add(mesh);\n  });\n}",
  "old_string": "// 一页的 3×3 卡袋内容。front=true 正面卡面（可点检视），false 卡背（翻面页背面）\n// faceDown=true 仅用于翻页动页的背面（局部朝下，翻转后朝上）；静止页一律朝上\nfunction fillPockets(parent, pageIdx, front, xSign, y, faceDown) {\n  const cards = albumCardsOf(album.race, pageIdx);\n  cards.forEach((def, k) => {\n    const col = k % 3, row = Math.floor(k / 3);\n    let mesh;\n    if (front) {\n      const ci = CARDS.findIndex(c => c.name === def.name);\n      const artKey = def.name + '|art';\n      if (!texCache[artKey]) texCache[artKey] = makeTex(drawCardFace(def, ci));\n      const n = collection[def.name] || 0;\n      mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(BINDER.cardW, BINDER.cardH),\n        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: n > 0 ? 0xffffff : 0x8a8a8a, transparent: true, opacity: n > 0 ? 1 : 0.55, map: texCache[artKey] }));\n      mesh.userData = { ci };\n    } else {\n      mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(BINDER.cardW, BINDER.cardH), cardBackMat());\n    }\n    mesh.rotation.x = faceDown ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2;\n    mesh.position.set(xSign * (0.15 + BINDER.colX[col]), y, BINDER.rowZ[row]);\n    parent.add(mesh);\n  });\n}",

}

根本原因是翻页条件中写成了 `next >= leafCount`：当卡牌页数为偶数时（如壁垒共 28 张卡，分为 4 页，对应 2 张活页），最后一张活页的背面页（第 4 页）只有翻到左侧才能看到，但该条件不允许将活页翻到最后，因此最后一页永远无法显示。

现在允许 `leafIdx` 到达 `leafCount`：最后一张活页可以翻到左侧，最后一页显示在左页，右页显示为封底（这是正常的活页夹状态），继续前翻会被阻止，翻回则不受影响。已通过自动化测试逐步验证了壁垒的翻页流程：0→1→2 页均可翻到，翻到最后一页后继续前翻会停在原地，翻回时 2→1→0 正常，领取流程的回归测试也未发现问题。

音效已丰富并部署（`dd436d5`）。全部为 WebAudio 程序合成，无外部音频资源。`noiseBurst` 已扩展为支持滤波类型（低通/带通/高通）、扫频和延迟。新增了 8 种音效：

**拆卡包/卡盒**
- `tear` 撕卡包：带通噪声向下扫频，配合三次短促的撕裂声，在包装被撕开时触发（此前提前了 0.5 秒，现已调整）。
- `boxOpen` 撕卡盒：低频闷响和持续时间更长、更粗粝的撕裂声。
- `whoosh` 卡牌扇形展开：带通噪声向上扫频。
- `scatter` 小卡包排开或散卡时：随机改变音高，形成一连串短促的碰撞声。
- `gridDone` 卡盒全部开完并平铺：轻快的三连上行音。

**集卡册**
- `albumOpen` 打开书架或翻开卡册：低鸣，配合皮革厚纸摩擦声。
- `pageTurn` 活页翻页：纸张挥动时的上扫音，0.45 秒后在页面落下时播放轻拍声。
- `claim` 领取传说奖励：华丽上行琶音、高频闪光声和空气感高频噪声（替代原来普通开包的音效）。

first : JSON.stringify(first);\n  }\n  v = (v || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim();\n  return v.length > 60 ? v.slice(0, 57) + '…' : v;\n};\n\nfor (const l of lines) {\n  if (!l.trim()) continue;\n  let j; try { j = JSON.parse(l); } catch (e) { continue; }\n  if (j.type === 'turn.prompt') {\n    cur = { userText: null, events: [] };\n    turns.push(cur);\n    if (j.origin && j.origin.kind === 'user') {\n      cur.userText = (j.input || []).filter(p => p.type === 'text').map(p => p.text).join('\\n');\n    }\n    continue;\n  }\n  if (j.type === 'usage.record' && j.usage) {\n    totalTokens += (j.usage.inputOther || 0) + (j.usage.output || 0) + (j.usage.inputCacheRead || 0) + (j.usage.inputCacheCreation || 0);\n    continue;\n  }\n  if (j.type === 'context.append_loop_event' && cur) {\n    const e = j.event;\n    if (e.type === 'content.part' || e.type === 'tool.call' || e.type === 'tool.result') {\n      cur.events.push(e);\n      if (e.type === 'tool.call') {\n        toolCallCount++;\n        callSummaries[e.toolCallId] = { name: e.name, summary: summarize(e.name, e.args) };\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nconst esc = s => s; // markdown 原样输出（与旧导出一致）\nconst out = [];\nconst userTurns = turns.filter(t => t.userText != null);\nconst firstPrompt = userTurns.length ? userTurns[0].userText : '';\nconst now = new Date();\nconst pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');\nconst stamp = `${now.getFullYear()}${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(now.getDate())}-${pad(now.getHours())}${pad(now.getMinutes())}${pad(now.getSeconds())}`;\nconst msgCount = turns.reduce((a, t) => a + t.events.length, 0) + userTurns.length;\n\nout.push('---');\nout.push(`session_id: session_5770d055-91db-4eb5-9908-1cd58ebf6739`);\nout.push(`exported_at: ${now.toISOString()}`);\nout.push(`work_dir: D:\\\\dev\\\\k3\\\\card-game`);\nout.push(`message_count: ${msgCount}`);\nout.push(`token_count: ${totalTokens}`);\nout.push('---\\n');\nout.push('# Kimi Session Export\\n');\nout.push('## Overview\\n');\nout.push(`- **Topic**: ${firstPrompt.slice(0, 80)}${firstPrompt.length > 80 ?
